Title: Nikhil and the Family

Cast

1. Nikhil - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Pallavi - 35 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The snowy hillside - white snow, deodar trees
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Nikhil stands in the courtyard. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil runs to Mother.]

Pallavi (happily): "I'm ready!"

[Nikhil tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Nikhil (gently): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil searches for his lost ball.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The snowy hillside - Day

[Nikhil stands in the snow. Pallavi stands near him.]

Pallavi: "So, here we are!"

[Snow starts to fall.]

Pallavi: "What happened?"

[Nikhil makes a snowball and throws it at Mother.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil builds a snowman.]

Nikhil: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil catches snowflakes in his hands.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil slides down the snowy slope.]

Pallavi: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

Pallavi: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil munches on an apple.]

Nikhil: "Yes, of course."

[Nikhil serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Nikhil sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Pallavi: "Hey, look at that!"

[Nikhil watches cartoons on TV.]

Nikhil: "Let's see."

[Nikhil flops down on the sofa.]

Nikhil: "What a day to remember!"
